name: web_lens_bhmerger_b3
dump:
({
 holes: SIM.state.bodies.filter(b => b.type === 'bh').sort((a, b) => b.mass - a.mass)
   .map(h => ({ pos: h.viz.group.position.toArray(), rs: h.rsScene, mass: h.mass })),
 cam: { pos: SIM.camera.position.toArray(), quat: SIM.camera.quaternion.toArray(), fov: SIM.camera.fov },
 discIntensity: SIM.state.discIntensity, discTemp: SIM.state.discTemp,
 discOuter: (SIM.state.preset && SIM.state.preset.discOuter) || 15,
 sky: SIM.state.sky, band: SIM.state.band })
